sentences.en: You've made remarkable progress in English in the past year.
sentences.zh: 你过去一年在英语学习上取得了显著的进步。

sentences.en: This company achieved a remarkable increase in turnover last year.
sentences.zh: 这家公司去年营业额有了大幅增长。

sentences.en: Lindbergh's solo nonstop transatlantic flight was a remarkable accomplishment.
sentences.zh: 林德伯格独自完成的大西洋非停靠飞行是一项非凡的成就。

senses.zh: 异常的，引人注目的，,卓越的,显著的,非凡的，非常（好）的
